name: application-sprint-burndown-chart
title: Sprint Burndown Chart
description: An ideal-vs-actual remaining-work line chart over a sprint, with a today marker showing exactly where the team stands against the planned pace.
useWhen: Tracking agile sprint progress where the team needs to see actual remaining work against the ideal linear pace.
A vertical 'today' marker helps distinguish completed days from remaining days at a glance.
avoidWhen: You're tracking cumulative completed work rather than remaining work — a burn-up chart communicates that direction more naturally.
The work isn't time-boxed into a sprint — a generic line chart from `charts` fits open-ended trend tracking better.
responsiveBehavior: The chart is a single SVG with viewBox scaling that shrinks proportionally with its container; day labels below the chart stay anchored to Day 0, Today, and the final day regardless of width.
accessibility: The ideal line uses a dashed stroke and the actual line a solid stroke, distinguishing them by pattern in addition to color.
The today marker is a dashed vertical line paired with a 'Today' text label below the axis, not conveyed by position alone.
The header states the exact remaining points and days left as text, not solely inferred from the chart's visual endpoint.

variants.title: Ten-day sprint
variants.description: A 10-day sprint burndown: dashed gray ideal-pace line, solid blue actual-remaining-work line ending at today with a marker dot, and a dashed red today line.
accessibility: Ideal and actual lines are distinguished by both color and dash pattern, and both are labeled in a text legend.

variants.title: Ten-day sprint (Dark)
variants.description: Sprint burndown chart adapted for dark surfaces, with line and marker colors re-tuned for dark contrast.
accessibility: Line strokes and the today marker meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background.
